name: Ukikura
author: Nauflix
changelog: Ukikura v1.0.6 (Patch 48 - Eliminasi Bug Black Box, Offline Bundled Runtime & Ultra-Low Resource Bridge): Mengembalikan visual 100% transparan tanpa bug black box dengan DirectComposition swapchain per-pixel alpha Electron teroptimasi. Membundel runtime Electron mandiri secara penuh ke dalam installer (100% instalasi offline tanpa unduh internet), ditenagai ukikura-bridge.exe C# native (< 1 MB RAM, 0% CPU) dan WhatsApp Web on-demand (~120 MB total RAM, idle CPU 0.0%-0.2%).
